description: Check the shop's texting registration with Twilio and save it: unregistered, brand_pending, campaign_pending, tollfree_pending, approved or failed, with the next step. A local number needs 10DLC (a brand and a campaign); a toll-free number needs toll-free verification. Texts only go out by text once it is approved, and Doing Work re-checks it daily. Give messaging_service_sid once, after creating the shop's Messaging Service in Twilio (10DLC only). Owner or office.
